name: recipes-site-web
description: Front-end assets for the recipes site: the Tailwind CSS build and htmx (self-hosted so Renovate tracks it). Used by the Dockerfile at image-build time and locally for dev.

scripts.build: tailwindcss -i src/recipes_site/static/input.css -o src/recipes_site/static/output.css --minify && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js src/recipes_site/static/htmx.min.js
